description: This file defines the ProductDescription class, which models product description details in an e-commerce system, including metadata for SEO and highlights. It extends Description and is mapped to the PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION database table.

classes.name: ProductDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing detailed product descriptions including metadata and product highlights, mapped to the PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION table.

methods.name: getProductExternalDl
methods.description: Returns the external download link for the product.

methods.name: setProductExternalDl
methods.description: Sets the external download link for the product.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Returns the search engine friendly URL.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the search engine friendly URL.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with this description.
